 Received money from abroad: Ukrainians explained when taxes must be paid and declarations submitted
 12:05, 8 November 2026
 2 min 
 If there are no documents about foreign income and taxes paid abroad, the deadline for submitting the declaration can be extended until December 31 of the following year. 
 Follow the latest news on SUD.UA social networks
 Follow the latest news on SUD.UA social networks 
 Income that Ukrainian citizens receive from sources outside the country must be declared and taxed in Ukraine. Exceptions are receipts exempt from taxation according to the Tax Code of Ukraine or international treaties. Only the latest: read SUD.UA on Telegram 
 As explained by the tax authorities, individuals who independently determine the amount of tax liabilities based on the submission of the property status and income declaration must pay it by August 1 of the year following the reporting year.
 At the same time, if the last day of the established deadline falls on a weekend or holiday, the payment deadline is considered the next business day.
 When the declaration submission deadline can be extended 
 For citizens who received income from foreign sources, the Tax Code provides a special procedure in case of absence of documents necessary to confirm the amount of income received and tax paid abroad.
 If such documents are not available at the time of submitting the declaration, the taxpayer has the right to submit an application to extend the declaration submission deadline until December 31 of the year following the reporting year.
 In this case, the tax liabilities indicated in the declaration must be paid within 10 calendar days after the last day of the extended submission deadline. That is, the funds must be transferred by January 10.
 Which codes to use for paying taxes 
 Tax liabilities determined by an individual based on the results of annual declaration are paid using the corresponding budget classification codes:
 11010500 — personal income tax paid by citizens based on the results of annual declaration;
 11011001 — military tax paid based on the declaration results.
 Current details of budget accounts for tax transfers, considering the administrative-territorial structure of Ukraine, are published on the State Tax Service web portal in the "Budget Accounts" section.
 The obligation to pay tax liabilities arises for an individual based on the independent determination of the respective amounts in the property status and income tax declaration.
